title: T3.3: storage.rs + app.rs — Export/import types.toml, ImportStory type handling

text:
Requirements: R34, R35. Files: src/storage.rs, src/app.rs, src/mcp.rs.
AC: ProjectExport.types: Vec<TypeDef> with serde(default); export_project includes types; import_project restores types.toml; import writes StoryTypeSet for typed stories; bulk_create maps story_type; round-trip test passes.
